about_short_description.short_description: Tennr is a healthcare AI startup that provides an automation platform for medical documents.

product.name: Tennr Automation Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates the processing of medical documents, including classification, data extraction, eligibility checks, and benefits investigations to streamline patient intake and referral management.

product.name: Tennr Workflow Manager
product.description: A tool within the platform that manages and coordinates complex healthcare operational workflows such as eligibility checks, prior authorizations, and communication with providers and patients.

product.name: RaeLM™ Vision-Language Model
product.description: A proprietary AI model trained to interpret unstructured medical records and match them against complex payor criteria for accurate document processing and authorization.
